positiveComments:
Ive been using these pore pads for about 2 months now (2-3x per week) and im pmeasantly surprised with results! For reference, my skincare routine is MINIMAL due to my skin being acne-prone and panicky when new ingredients are introduced. I use a fragrance free moisuizing bar soap for cleansing (yes I know thats terrible, but "cleansers" cause breakouts on me), these pore pads, and a ceramide moisturizer before bed (still searching for a good one for long term use itherwise I'd list it here). After 3 uses of these pore pads, me and my husband both noticed a reduction in the prominance of my nose blackheads. After 2 months, I still feel like the blackheads and pores are shrinking, albeit VERY slowly. This was not an overnight success so know that you should try it for a long period befoe making a judgement. 

One thing I wish Id realized before starting use was that it really does need a moisturizer to follow it. The first two times I used it I didnt follow with a moisturizer and it dried my skin WAY out. But after pausing use and moisturizing for the  next few days I was able to restart using the pads (+ a moisturizer) without dryness. 

I am extremely prone to breakouts (one day of foundation and my clear skin is toast) and so my biggest concern was that this would break me out. It didnt. In fact, I've been using it to help clear breakouts caused by occasional makeup use. I do believe I'll be purchasing again.
negativeComments: I brought into all the hype regarding this product. Recommended by a magazine's marketing. Worse mistake of my life. It started off so well. However, after four days, I began to see new breakouts. I lessened the use to three times a week, until I was only using it once a week. I chalked it up to purging, but was wrong. Even once a week, I was getting small irritated red bumps. The moment that I ceased using the product, my skin began to heal. Now I am stuck with a product I have no use for. I reached out to Ulta hoping they would take the product back for a store credit, but they were unwilling to assist.

reviews.headline: I would buy this product aain.
reviews.comment: I've seen this ad about the zero pore pads from medicube everywhere, and it looked legit and seemed to work for everyone, so I decided to give it a shot and see if it would work for me as well. It was around twenty dollars, so I had really hoped it would be well worth the money I spent on it. One side of the pad helps with exfoliation, and the other side is softer and helps lift excess off. Ever since mine came in, I have loved it. It has helped my skin so much with texture and made my skin shine. The zero pore pads have truly transformed my skin after just a few uses; I noticed my pores have actually looked visibly smaller, and my skin feels smoother. It has a very lightweight texture, so it doesn't leave a greasy or heavy feeling afterwards. I think my  expectations went through the roof. If I'm honest, I didn't have high hopes for the product. I thought it would be another thing I would buy to try to help my skin, and it would just fail me like all the other products I have bought. It did wonders for my skin, enough for me to want to repurchase another one once I finish my first container. I would truly and honestly recommend this for anyone who is struggling with larger pores and uneven texture like me. This product delivers great results and is definitely a gamechanger for my skincare routine. I would give this product 5 stars!

reviews.headline: Love this product!!
reviews.comment: I have been using these pads once a day consistently for two weeks so far, and I'm seeinf such substantial progress! I struggle with texture on my higher cheek bones and on my chin, under my bottom lip. In just two weeks, this has reduced that texture by 35% at least. I cannot wait to keep using and see how much texture I can eliminate completely. Nothing else has ever worked for me with the speed this has.
